notes: No C++ AC in the corpus. orig.cpp follows the official editorial (the answer is the least w whose distance <= w graph is not bipartite) on an O(N) edge set: the 6-nearest-neighbour edges shorter than the least 6th-neighbour distance, from a k-d tree, then Kruskal with a parity DSU. It matches a binary-search-plus-BFS brute force over all pairs on 1500 small gen.py cases.
